description: Bay Input: a transmitter that carries eight polyphonic signals to Bay Output and Bay Norm modules anywhere in the patch, with no cable and no sample delay

inputs.text: One of eight signals carried to every Bay Output and Bay Norm linked to this module; a name given to the port in its context menu appears as a label above it

notes: this module has no outputs; its eight signals reach the patch only through a Bay Output or Bay Norm that has picked it in that module's own source menu item
renaming the module later does not break a link, because the link is held by module id rather than by name
menu: Bay Input name — a text field naming this module; the name is drawn at the top of the panel and identifies the module in the source list of every Bay Output and Bay Norm
